'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War on drugs]]
**[[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
***Six people are killed in a [[United States Armed Forces|U.S.]] missile strike on a suspected drug-running boat in the [[Caribbean Sea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-cartels-hegseth-drugs-boat-strikes-6c3316b2852723e26c39dc701bba9d52 (AP)]
***The [[United States]] deploys the [[USS Gerald R. Ford|USS ''Gerald R. Ford'']] [[carrier battle group]] to [[Latin America]] for counter-[[drug cartel]] operations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-military-deploy-aircraft-carrier-south-america-amid-soaring-tensions-with-2025-10-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]], [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]
***An 18-year-old [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man is killed after being shot and critically injured yesterday during an [[Israel]]i attack in the [[Askar Camp]] in [[Nablus]], occupied [[Palestine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/24/palestinian-child-killed-in-israeli-raid-on-west-bank-as-settlers-rampage (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three people are killed in a roadside bombing on a police vehicle in a former stronghold of the [[Pakistani Taliban]] in [[Hangu District, Pakistan|Hangu District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/roadside-bombing-kills-3-police-officers-in-northwest-pakistan/ar-AA1P6JgC?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=8be551395b7548d3bdc7ef96e45d5d64&ei=6 (''The Canadian Press'')]

**Three people are killed and two others injured during two [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s against two vehicles in [[Toul, Lebanon|Toul]] and [[Nabatieh]], [[Lebanon]]. Senior [[Hezbollah]] commander Abbas Karki is among the fatalities. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-drone-strikes-target-vehicle-in-southern-lebanon/3726520 (AA)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Booker Prize|Booker Prize Foundation]] announces the creation of the [[Children's Booker Prize]], with the first [[Pound sterling|£]]50,000 ([[United States dollar|US]]$66,500) winner to be announced in early 2027. [https://www.theguardian.com/books/2025/oct/24/booker-prize-launches-childrens-booker-frank-cottrell-boyce (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**At least four people are killed in [[Haiti]] and the [[Dominican Republic]] by [[Tropical Storm Melissa (2025)|Tropical Storm Melissa]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2025/10/23/weather/tropical-storm-melissa-hurricane (''The New York Times'')] [https://apnews.com/article/storm-melissa-caribbean-jamaica-haiti-dominican-republic-5532dedc71d40c74a88679ee899ffc5d (AP)]
*Twenty-five people are killed and several others are injured in a fire on a bus in [[Kurnool]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-andhra-pradesh-bus-fire-322b1b4779b0ca32ab3614ea04421e6c (AP)]
*Fourteen people are killed, two others are rescued, and two are reported missing when a rubber boat sinks off the coast of [[Bodrum]], [[Muğla]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/fourteen-dead-after-migrant-boat-sinks-off-western-turkey/ar-AA1P7zLj?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=3f94ccf0bf8d46a9dae3f1841e9cce47&ei=16 (DPA International)]
*Four people are killed and over 21,000 others are affected during heavy rains in [[Sri Lanka]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20251024/3de8864542e244f4bc21d57137245437/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Colombia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions on [[President of Colombia|Colombian president]] [[Gustavo Petro]], his wife [[Verónica Alcocer]], his son [[Nicolás Petro|Nicolás]], and Interior Minister [[Armando Benedetti]], accusing them of involvement in the [[Illegal drug trade|global drug trade]] amid worsening relations between both countries. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-colombia-petro-sanctions-drug-trafficking-1b6ead338ec266b3df40859db6ee2d8d (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Ovruch train attack]]
**A man detonates a [[grenade]] on a train in [[Ovruch]], [[Zhytomyr Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing three women and a border guard, and wounding 12 other people. The perpetrator, who also died in the explosion, was a [[fugitive]] from [[Kharkiv]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/man-kills-himself-three-women-ukrainian-railway-station-2025-10-24/ (Reuters)] [https://news.az/news/grenade-blast-on-ukrainian-train-leves-four-dead-several-injured (News.az)]
*[[2025 Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan protests]]
**[[Pakistan]] bans the [[Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan|Tehreek-e-Labbaik]] party after deadly clashes between party members and [[Law enforcement in Pakistan|Pakistani police]] during a protest march led by the party over the past two weeks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-bans-islamist-party-tehreek-e-labaik-pakistan-under-anti-terrorism-law-2025-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Azerbaijan–Russia relations]], [[Media freedom in Azerbaijan]]
**A [[Judiciary of Azerbaijan|court]] in [[Azerbaijan]] orders a senior [[Russia]]n journalist of [[Mass media in Russia|state media]] agency [[Sputnik (news agency)|Sputnik]] be released from prison and placed under [[house arrest]] for three months. The decision comes after a meeting between [[Azerbaijani President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] and [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] in [[Tajikistan]] amid [[2025 Azerbaijan–Russia diplomatic crisis|deteriorating relations]] between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/azerbaijan-moves-russian-state-journalist-house-arrest-jail-after-freeing-his-2025-10-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Murders of Albert Alfonso and Paul Longworth]]
**A [[Courts of England and Wales|court]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], sentences a [[Colombians in the United Kingdom|Colombian man]] to [[Life imprisonment in England and Wales|life in prison]] for the murder and dismemberment of two men in London in July 2024. The man also pleaded guilty to three counts of possession of [[child pornography]]. [https://apnews.com/article/britain-colombia-murder-suitcases-5280a733be68ac91c06a8a546ca82e5f (AP)]
*[[Pork barrel scam]]
**The [[Philippines]]' [[Sandiganbayan|anti-graft court]] acquits former [[President of the Senate of the Philippines|Senate president]] [[Juan Ponce Enrile]], his former chief of staff Gigi Reyes, and businesswoman [[Janet Lim-Napoles]] of their remaining [[Graft (politics)|graft]] charges, citing failure to prove their guilt. The three had been charged over their alleged misuse of the [[Priority Development Assistance Fund]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2129441/enrile-acquitted-of-remaining-graft-charges-in-pork-barrel-case/ (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/nation/2025/10/24/enrile-acquitted-of-graft-in-pork-barrel-case-1019 (ABS-CBN News)]
*A [[Manhunt (law enforcement)|manhunt]] is launched for [[Ethiopia]]n national Hadush Gerberslasie Kebatu, whose [[sexual assault]] of a 14-year-old girl sparked [[2025 British anti-immigration protests|anti-immigration protests]] in [[Epping, Essex]], [[England]], after he was accidentally released from prison. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2d5rl36vgo (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Irish presidential election]]
**Citizens of the [[Republic of Ireland]] vote for the next [[President of Ireland|President]] to succeed [[Michael D. Higgins]], who is term-limited. The candidates are [[independent politician|independent]] candidate [[Catherine Connolly]] and [[Fine Gael]] candidate [[Heather Humphreys]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2y04znx4ro (BBC)]
*The [[Croatia]]n [[Croatian Parliament|parliament]] votes to reintroduce [[Conscription|compulsory military service]], which had been shifted to a volunteer system in 2008. The new conscription will require two months of [[basic training]], allowing [[Conscientious objector|conscientious objectors]] to opt for civilian service. [https://apnews.com/article/croatia-compulsory-military-service-ukraine-32c84a8c4afc8790bee82644d8366e46 (AP)]
